description: This source file defines the Layout class for the OpenCart administration module, responsible for CRUD operations related to layout management including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving layouts, routes, and associated modules within the admin panel.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: Represents layout management functionalities for the admin interface, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving layouts and their associated routes and modules.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Inserts a new layout record into the database, along with its associated routes and modules if provided.

methods.name: editLayout
methods.description: Updates an existing layout's details and its associated routes and modules based on provided data.

methods.name: deleteLayout
methods.description: Removes a layout and all its associated routes and modules from the database.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific layout by its ID.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Fetches a list of layouts with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalLayouts
methods.description: Returns the total number of layouts available in the system.

methods.name: addRoute
methods.description: Associates a route with a specific layout, storing store ID and route details.

methods.name: deleteRoutes
methods.description: Deletes all routes associated with a specific layout ID.

methods.name: deleteRoutesByLayoutId
methods.description: Removes all routes linked to a particular layout ID.

methods.name: deleteRoutesByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all routes associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Fetches all routes for a specific layout ID.

methods.name: getRoutesByStoreId
methods.description: Retrieves all routes that are associated with a particular store ID.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Associates a module with a specified layout, including code, position, and sort order.

methods.name: deleteModules
methods.description: Deletes all modules linked to a specific layout ID.

methods.name: deleteModulesByCode
methods.description: Deletes all modules matching a specific code or pattern.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Retrieves all modules assigned to a particular layout ID, ordered by position and sort order.
